about: OH's demo config: the one file a solutions engineer edits first (docs/demo-kit/Demo-Kit-Design.md §2.4), written from the governing design, docs/lg/OH-Demo-Design.md (§1 the name and palette, §2 the surfaces and slots, §3 the dimensions with their memory, §4 the sixteen beats, §5 the data, §7 the lanes). scripts/demo-kit/new-demo.mjs scaffolds the demo from it. It holds no credential: the sign-in demo account is a fictional name, and its secret exists only on the worker. Served with the page (public/ is served wholesale), so nothing here is private.
name: OH

brand.title: OH. | TVs, laundry and the kitchen
brand.legal: OH. is a fictional home brand built for a demonstration. Products, their names, images and prices are real as listed publicly on 1 October 2026; offers, packages and regional sales are representative. Price, financing and rebate eligibility never vary by where someone lives or by inferred income.

region.about: Synthetic sales for every state over the five allowlisted dimensions, with the real regional fuel skew (gas cooking about 38% nationally, about 70% in California and New Jersey; dryers 80% electric): Lane D1's scripts/demo-kit/configs/oh/region.json is the source; this vocabulary is the seed door's closed list and must equal it

accounts.name: Dana Whitfield
accounts.about: the shopper the walk follows, signed in on her phone at beat 15

copy.coldStartSentence: aggregate, never the individual; we curate, never price.
copy.scoredSentence: No census term enters any score. The census figure explains the lean; the lean is the brand’s own sales, seeded here as synthetic data.

roadmap: A piece only where its rule admits it: companions on the product page gate on ctx.anchor until complements lands; a condition the request does not carry fails closed.
The search term lifts the category it names, as context, never as evidence about her; the receipt itemises it.
The brand’s own regional sales blended by λ = K / (K + Σa), giving way as her evidence grows.
The rails over the products file; at an affinity weight of zero the site’s own order exactly.
A piece names the products it completes, and a slot rule prefers it, itemised on the receipt (engine lane E1).
Two named outcomes credited to the decision that earned them, counted in the day report (engine lane E1).
The TV grid leans with the state, as the homepage already does (engine lane E1).
